title: mauricioroza/gencorr pipeline - params.input schema
description: One row per GWAS summary statistics file (one trait).

id.errorMessage: id must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, '_', '.', '-' (it becomes a file name and a LAVA phenotype ID)

sumstats.description: Path or URL of a summary statistics file, or a GWAS Catalog accession (e.g. GCST90000016) to download the study's harmonised file
sumstats.errorMessage: sumstats must be a path or URL of a summary statistics file (no spaces), or a GWAS Catalog accession such as GCST90000016

n.errorMessage: n must be a positive number (total sample size; used only when the file has no N column)

n_cases.errorMessage: n_cases must be a positive number

n_controls.errorMessage: n_controls must be a positive number

pop_prev.errorMessage: pop_prev must be between 0 and 1 (population prevalence, binary traits only)

ancestry.errorMessage: ancestry must be EUR or EAS (GWAS ancestry; default EUR). It selects the LD references (--ldsc_ld/--lava_ref for EUR, --ldsc_ld_eas/--lava_ref_eas for EAS); pairs of different ancestry are analysed only by Popcorn.

build.errorMessage: build must be GRCh37 or GRCh38 (genome build of the file's positions; default GRCh37). Only used to pick the rsID map for variants without an rsID.

label.errorMessage: label is a free-text display name
